title: Splitting off several isolated fibre points by a finite part over an etale neighbourhood
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a separated locally finite type morphism and finitely many pairwise distinct isolated points of a fibre, the lemma produces an elementary etale neighbourhood and a decomposition of the base change into open and closed pieces such that each of the distinguished pieces is finite over the neighbourhood with a single point over the base point mapping to the corresponding given point with equal residue field. The proof separates the points using separatedness, builds finite pieces for each, and assembles the open and closed decomposition. Producing the decomposition with all the stated fibrewise conditions is the load-bearing part. Retained author proof at lines 12114-12129.
